verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents some native operations that span many pages at once. Docs Audit runs Linter rules against every page in a single pass, Reusable Content edits propagate to all instances automatically, and Branches save changes across pages together. However, there is no documented general-purpose bulk edit, move, delete or AI-driven batch rewrite across selected items. Missing for 10: general bulk edit/move/delete of pages, AI Agent batch edits across many pages, bulk actions through the API or CLI, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Docs Audit runs your Linter rules against every page in your project in a single pass
Score your entire documentation against your style guide in one run.
When you edit a block, the system updates all instances automatically.
Branches allow admins to save changes across pages without them going live immediately.
